title: Buchi Emecheta's birth chart
metaDescription: Buchi Emecheta's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 28.5° Cancer. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Five of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Leo — the Moon, Mercury, Venus, Jupiter and Pluto. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 28.5° of Cancer is the Sun's exact seat — third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by Jupiter in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Leo (18.4°), Venus in Leo (5.2°), Mars in Virgo (5.7°): thought that arrives already in motion, attraction declared rather than implied, effort banked steadily until it tells.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than Mars and Saturn: 1.8° from an exact sextile. A sextile is an offer rather than a given: available when it is reached for, quiet when it is not. Behind it, Saturn square Neptune at 2.1°, and Venus conjunction Pluto at 2.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Every angle named here holds for the whole of that day at the birthplace, so an unknown hour cannot take it away.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags a single placement in this chart. Saturn in Cancer at 4.0° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 5 fire, 2 water, 2 air, 1 earth by element and 5 fixed, 3 cardinal, 2 mutable by mode. A fire emphasis is read as appetite for the first move, with information gathered by doing rather than before doing. Nothing was retrograde that day, which is less common than it sounds.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Leo for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.1° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 12.3°.
